sources.quote: HD 260655 has two confirmed rocky planets, named HD 260655 b and HD 260655 c, that were discovered in 2022.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 260655. Its orbit and size follow Luque et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: Both planets were detected by the TESS mission and confirmed independently with archival and new precise radial velocity data obtained with the HIRES observatory since 1998, and the CARMENES survey instruments since 2016.
